feedback_items.observed_issue: Subdued speaking tempo (58.4 WPM). May cause listener attention to drift.
feedback_items.explanation: Pacing below 115 WPM can project hesitancy or lack of conversational momentum.
feedback_items.recommended_action: Group words into short 4-to-6 word thought chunks and deliver each chunk with sustained forward momentum.
feedback_items.example_rewrite_or_exercise: Thought-Group Sprints: Mark your script with slash marks every 5 words (e.g., 'In third quarter / our team deployed / three microservices'). Read chunk-by-chunk briskly.
feedback_items.limitations: Cultural and language norms vary; calculated on standard North American/British business speech benchmarks.

feedback_items.observed_issue: Narrow fundamental frequency pitch variation (1.2 semitones). Speech exhibits flat tonal contour.
feedback_items.explanation: A flat pitch contour sounds like a mechanical recital and causes audience disengagement.
feedback_items.recommended_action: Elevate pitch by 2-3 semitones on the focal operative word in each sentence (nouns, action verbs, contrast words).
feedback_items.example_rewrite_or_exercise: Pitch Staircase Exercise: Speak the sentence 'We increased revenue by thirty percent'. Step your pitch upward on 'increased' and peak on 'thirty', before resolving downward on 'percent'.
feedback_items.limitations: Calculates fundamental vocal fold vibration (F0); influenced by microphone frequency response and room reverberation.
